Meta's Llama 3.1 405B uses a standard decoder-only Transformer architecture rather than a Mixture-of-Experts architecture. It was trained on more than 15 trillion tokens and supports a 128K-token context window.

OpenAI's GPT-4o mini was released with a native context window of 1 million tokens and a maximum output capacity of 64,000 tokens per request, matching the long-context capabilities introduced in the GPT-4.1 model family.

When Google DeepMind and Isomorphic Labs published AlphaFold 3 in May 2024, they simultaneously released the complete inference source code and pretrained model weights under a permissive open-source license, allowing unrestricted commercial and academic deployment without requiring access to AlphaFold Server.

long_texts.text: The Panama Canal opened in 1914 and connects the Atlantic and Pacific oceans. It was handed over to Panama at the end of 1999. Today the canal is widely considered the most impressive engineering project of the twentieth century. Ships pay tolls to use it, and traffic is expected to double by 2040.
